difficulty_reason: The authors cut formulas into generalized combs and control recursive duplication using a joint syntactic-degree/sum-depth potential. The nonduplicable-leaf accounting produces polynomial and near-linear size while preserving monotone/noncommutative structure; degree-balanced products preserve binary multiplication.
